svg.title: Contact sheet: Inertial, fusion and quantum sensors
svg.desc: One tile per scenario kind of the family Inertial, fusion and quantum sensors, each the chart the engine writes for a bundled example of that kind, labelled with the kind and its ledger status: inertial MODELLED 6 · VALIDATED 2; hybrid MODELLED; fusion MODELLED 4 · VALIDATED 4; hybrid-ukf MODELLED (result label); gnss-ins MODELLED (result label); ins-trn-coast VALIDATED; quantum-gnss-free-nav MODELLED (result label); quantum-anomaly-detect MODELLED (result label); quantum-trade MODELLED 1 · VALIDATED 2. Modelled results from stated inputs, not measurements. Advisory: not type-approved navigation equipment.
